title: LATTICE P0 OFFLINE INITIALIZE-PARSE-DIAGNOSIS
objective: 離線比較 parse-error attempt 的持久 request/stdout/framing 證據與已知成功 initialize framing，精確定位 JSON-RPC -32700 的客戶端/包裝器根因並提出最小可逆修正；絕不啟動 binary 或接觸 runtime。
root_cause: Invoke-LatticeMcp.ps1 calls Process.StandardInput.WriteLine for the first JSON-RPC frame under Windows PowerShell 5.1/.NET Framework. Process.StartWithCreateProcess constructs StandardInput with Console.InputEncoding and sets AutoFlush=true. Console.InputEncoding is UTF-8 with preamble EFBBBF, and AutoFlush emits that preamble before WriteLine. latticed retains bytes through LF and passes the complete frame to serde_json::from_slice; EF is neither JSON whitespace nor a JSON value prefix, so server returns JSON-RPC -32700 Parse error.

failure_artifact_inventory.evidence_gap: The live request bytes lack an independent durable capture; exact frame below is source-and-host reconstruction, corroborated by the unique server -32700 path.

offending_expression.wrong_assumption: Redirected Process.StandardInput is UTF-8 without BOM and WriteLine only adds a newline.
offending_expression.actual_behavior: On this Windows PowerShell 5.1/.NET Framework host, AutoFlush emits UTF-8 BOM before the first JSON line; WriteLine then adds CRLF.

differential_findings.json_content: PASS; failure JSON body is valid after BOM removal and contains required initialize fields.
differential_findings.content_length_or_framing_assumption: EXCLUDED; both attempts use newline-delimited JSON and server explicitly reads through LF. No Content-Length is expected.
differential_findings.bom_or_encoding: ROOT_CAUSE; EFBBBF precedes the opening 7B byte only in reconstructed failure frame.
differential_findings.newline: NOT_CAUSAL; failure CRLF bytes 0D0A are accepted JSON whitespace by serde_json; known success uses LF.
differential_findings.protocol_version: NOT_CAUSAL; server initialize only requires a non-empty protocolVersion and successful response negotiated 2025-11-25.
differential_findings.extra_stdin: EXCLUDED_BY_SOURCE; initialize is the first Write-JsonLine call and runner invokes one Discovery action.
differential_findings.extra_stdout: EXCLUDED; captured stdout is exactly one server parse-error JSON line.
differential_findings.partial_read: EXCLUDED_BY_SERVER_SOURCE; read_bounded_frame loops and accumulates until LF before parsing.
differential_findings.server_parser_bug: EXCLUDED_AS_PRIMARY_CAUSE; server contract is newline-delimited JSON and serde_json correctly rejects BOM, which JSON does not define as whitespace.

secondary_diagnosis.cause: An initialize JSON-RPC error response has error but no result; StrictMode missing-property access prevents summary.json creation.

minimal_reversible_remediation.primary: Before Process.Start on Windows PowerShell 5.1, temporarily set Console.InputEncoding to UTF8Encoding(false), start the child so Process captures that no-BOM encoding, then restore the original encoding in finally. After start set Process.StandardInput.NewLine to LF. On runtimes exposing ProcessStartInfo.StandardInputEncoding, set it directly to UTF8Encoding(false) instead of mutating Console.InputEncoding.
